summary: Traffic sync must preserve the latest dataset while also appending provenance-rich snapshots that power movers and the persisted learnings loop.
reason: The intel workflow depends on week-over-week memory, so a regen must not return to a single overwritten data file or compute movers without source versions, date ranges, and input hashes.
validated_outcome: go test ./... covers snapshot provenance, retention compaction, movers --agent JSON, learnings append, and mover-led weekly digest.
